name: building
_doc: Wind-around-building domain for the centerline Build workflow. A ~40 x 30 x 15 m wind tunnel at h=0.25 m (160x120x60 = ~1.15M cells), air (rho=1.225). Workflow: load a centerline STEP, place/rotate it with the gizmo, set the domain size + voxel size if needed (Apply), press Build, then Start Simulation. Enlarge the domain (esp. height) for a bigger building or a lower blockage ratio; Build/Apply re-voxelize the placed house.
